node.statement: Consequently the valid outputs remain separate: 1.7.4 proves the explicit inverse statement R(u_pol,h_pol), and 1.7.5.1 proves the approximate-group statement G(u_grp). The scalar comparison A*epsilon_r<=C_grp*epsilon_r yields only the weakened G_{C_grp}(u_grp). Without equality of the relevant values of u_grp and u_pol, R(u_pol,h_pol) and G_{C_grp}(u_grp) do not imply the root conjunction R(u_pol,h_pol) and G_{C_grp}(u_pol). Therefore node 1.7.8 cannot discharge its parent from the permitted inputs.
